tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: the conversation, terminal surround and dialogs.

tokens.name: bg-pane
tokens.usage: Sidebar, side panel and card ground. Every text pair is checked on it.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text on bg and bg-pane.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ages, hosts, one-line summaries. 4.5:1 on bg-pane.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and panes. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action, selection, links. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, drag-over tint. In code: color-mix(accent 10%/16%, bg).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 1px offset. 3:1 on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: control-bg
tokens.usage: Button and input fill.

tokens.name: control-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Control hover.

tokens.name: control-bg-active
tokens.usage: Control pressed / aria-pressed.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Resting control border.

tokens.name: control-border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry state (selected, invalid). 3:1 on bg-pane.

tokens.name: control-fg
tokens.usage: Control labels.

tokens.name: control-fg-quiet
tokens.usage: Quiet control labels and icons.

tokens.name: usage-ok
tokens.usage: Context and quota meters below the warn threshold.

tokens.name: usage-warn
tokens.usage: Context and quota meters past warn.

tokens.name: usage-crit
tokens.usage: Context and quota meters past crit.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Session is running a turn. Text-safe on bg and bg-pane.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Session needs you: a question, permission or form. The attention colour.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Turn failed, stuck, CI red, verdict blocked.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Completed turn, CI green, PR ready or merged.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Idle, stopped, queued, closed. Never used for something that needs action.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid fields, destructive buttons.

tokens.name: syn-kw
tokens.usage: Code viewer: keywords (One Light / One Dark).

tokens.name: syn-str
tokens.usage: Code viewer: strings.

tokens.name: syn-num
tokens.usage: Code viewer: numbers.

tokens.name: syn-code
tokens.usage: Code viewer: identifiers and inline code.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Row metadata, chip labels, control text.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.sample: Waiting on you: approve the migration

styles.name: text-md
styles.sample: The hub is on 0.5.3 and healthy.

styles.name: text-xl
styles.usage: Page titles and the inbox greeting.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a chip; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section padding; side gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Every control's height: WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target. Do not raise it to fix a small control.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Primary dialog buttons and the composer send button.

tokens.name: control-px
tokens.usage: Control side padding.

tokens.name: control-px-lg
tokens.usage: Large control side padding.

tokens.name: control-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between adjacent controls.

tokens.name: layer-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the footer, the agent button and toasts in the bottom-right stack.

tokens.name: status-h
tokens.usage: Footer height, border included.

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: Agent button diameter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Reserved: aria-pressed toggles and the context meter.
